task_title: Build deterministic AI equipment loadout scoring

plan_review.notes: Refined without architectural fork: split legal transition construction from ERV scoring; added purchase cost, deterministic remaining encounter fixtures, and committed config; corrected tie-break to score then fingerprint then instance ID; removed disabled-slot rejection because runtime currently treats disabledSlots as inert; made next-minus-current the sole additive target with reconciled diagnostics; defined exact C2 ownership DTO semantics; expanded production-formula parity to accuracy, offense/crit, armor, cadence, and ability cooldown. Kept 3 apples by one pure module plus focused tests and narrow helper extraction only where no production seam exists; D1 compile repair is two type-predicate edits required by preflight.
